description: EIP-712 typed-data hashing and signature check: returns encodeType, typeHash, domain separator, struct hash and the final digest a wallet signs (eth_signTypedData_v4), and with a signature recovers the signer and compares it to an expected address. Summarises common payloads (ERC-2612 Permit, EIP-3009 TransferWithAuthorization used by x402 EVM payments, Permit2) so an agent can see what it is about to sign. POST JSON body. Price: $0.003 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/eip712-hash

signature.description: Optional 65-byte or 64-byte signature to recover the signer

typedData.description: The eth_signTypedData_v4 payload: {types, primaryType, domain, message} (EIP712Domain type optional, inferred from domain keys)
